Definition: from G1223 and G826; to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day):--dawn.
BiblicalUsage: To shine through is what the day star does in the heart, and Peter uses the word once, for the morning that rises when the prophetic word is heeded. The day dawns and the day star arises in your hearts, and the light that was outside becomes the light within.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day star in Peter is the promise that the word will not always be a lamp in the dark; the morning is coming when Christ Himself will rise in the heart, and the waiting is worth it.
